item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00154","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C16","C22","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.89,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"C16 is the closest because it directs an executive officer to proceed immediately with a defense-related program in cooperation with the National Military Establishment, but its voluntary steel-allocation machinery and letter format do not supply the child's reserve-unit organization, training, reporting, and citizen-enlistment provisions. C22 shares the armed-services setting and assignments to defense officials, while C04 concerns military manpower and includes a public exhortation, but those similarities remain topical or routine. No candidate displays distinctive shared language, a parallel operative sequence, or substantially the same administrative machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Defense, and the head of each department in the national Military Establishment, shall proceed without delay...to organize all reserve component units...and to establish vigorous and progressive programs...of training","parent_excerpt":"I am asking you to proceed immediately to develop a voluntary allocations program...covering the requirements of the Armed Forces for steel mill products...It will be necessary...for your office to work in the closest possible cooperation with the National Military Establishment","explanation":"C16 has the strongest linguistic and institutional overlap, but the common direction to proceed with a defense program is generic and the programs use materially different machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Defense shall within 60 days...submit to the President a report showing the action which has been taken","parent_excerpt":"The Committee shall...make such recommendations to the President and to said Secretaries as in the judgment of the Committee will effectuate the policy hereof.","explanation":"C22 also uses presidential oversight of defense administration, but it creates an advisory committee addressing equality, unlike the child's direct operational and timed reporting scheme."},{"child_excerpt":"Every citizen is urged to do his utmost in aiding the development of effective reserve components of our armed forces","parent_excerpt":"I urge all employers and Government agencies of all kinds...to give those under their charge sufficient time in which to fulfill the obligations of registration","explanation":"C04 contains a public exhortation in a military-manpower context, but exhortatory language is routine and the proclamation's registration system does not resemble the child's reserve organization and training program."}]}
